blocks.text: Verse 25 identifies the prophet as “Jonah son of Amittai.” Jonah 1:1 gives the same name and patronymic, so the two references may point to the same prophetic figure. That identification, however, does not establish that this eighth-century Jonah wrote the later third-person narrative in the book of Jonah; neither book makes that authorship claim.

Jeroboam II’s reign overlaps with Uzziah’s, a pairing that can locate the setting of a superscription in the mid-eighth century BCE. That chronological setting does not, by itself, date every part of a text or determine when its final form was completed.
